Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

Default (custom_size off): output follows image_1's aspect ratio, scaled to about resolution*resolution (default 1024, multiple of 32). This is not image_1's original pixel size. Set resolution to 0 to keep original sizes (rounded to 32).

Turn on custom_size to use the ResolutionSelector width/height as the canvas. Keep it close to the resized image_1 size, or the edit can shift.

A large stitched four-panel image shows a serene historical-romance visual centered on Lianhua, Peixinghang, and a blooming peach-blossom landscape. All four panels share a highly polished, realistic fashion-editorial photography aesthetic reminiscent of Journey's End Peach Grove, with warm golden-hour sunlight filtering through dense cherry or peach trees covered in pale pink blossoms. The color palette is dominated by blush pink, ivory, beige linen, weathered gray-brown soil, mossy greens, silver metal accessories, and softly diffused amber highlights. Thin straight seams divide the overall composite vertically, emphasizing that multiple related images have been placed together.

In the upper-left section, Lianhua, a young adult East Asian woman approximately in her twenties, stands three-quarter length within a rocky garden path framed by abundant flowering branches. She has a slim build, fair smooth skin, oval-to-heart-shaped face, long neck exposed above a high-waisted hanfu-style garment featuring a skirt cinched above the bust printed with small pale pink florals on a cream base, arched brows, defined eyes, subtle eyeliner, light rosy lipstick, and a composed expression as she gazes upward toward the sky and falling petals. A red decorative mark sits delicately at the center of her forehead. Her very long black hair falls down her back and over her shoulders in loose waves. On top of her elaborate hairstyle she wears ornate silver-and-blue embellishments including sculptural pins, chains, beadwork, dangling tassels, feather-like accents, and pastel silk flowers blending pink and blue tones in pink, powder blue, lavender-gray, and cream hues arranged near both sides of her head. Long drop earrings and necklace pieces hang from her ears and neckline, catching the light. She holds a round handheld fan decorated with raised-looking embroidery, gold edging, floral motifs, and a handle angled diagonally outward. Around her body flow semi-transparent chiffon scarves in milky white and pale rose, tied at the chest and draped widely around her arms; the fabric appears lightweight, rippling, and semi-sheer, creating elegant loops across the lower part of the frame. Behind her, irregular low walls made of rounded stones run horizontally and curve backward, partially covered by greenery. Large gnarled tree trunks rise out of focus in the midground, casting patterned shade onto the dirt pathway. Pink petal fragments drift in front of the lens at varying depths, some crisp and others softened by motion blur. Sunlight forms bright flecks on bark, leaf litter, clothing folds, and scattered debris on the path. This panel uses a shallow-depth-of-field cinematic crop with Lianhua positioned slightly right of center, the stone wall leading lines guiding attention deeper into the orchard, and distant hills faintly visible under hazy atmospheric light.

In the upper-right section, Peixinghang, a young adult East Asian man approximately in his late twenties, rides a white or palomino horse through a narrow rural road enclosed by blooming pink trees. He has an athletic average-tall build, tan complexion, sharp jawline, straight nose, thick eyebrows, dark expressive eyes, short wavy tousle-black hair styled naturally, and lightly stubbled facial texture. His mouth is held in a quiet neutral profile as he looks offscreen toward Lianhua located in the opposite direction. He wears a pale moon-white long-sleeved brocade tunic with woven geometric patterning across the fabric and darker trousers partly visible below. His waist features an embossed jade-inlaid leather belt. At his wrists are brown leather straps and rings connected visually to riding gloves or harness elements. His posture is upright but relaxed, seated deeply in the saddle, facing leftward toward the blossoms and possibly toward Lianhua elsewhere in the scene. One hand rests near the horse’s mane and reins while another hangs lower near the stirrup area. The horse occupies much of the lower half of this portion, shown in partial frontal-side angle with a creamy coat, alert ears, glossy eye, flared nostril, dark bridle, metal bits, rope rein, chest strap, and leather tack. Its head extends across the lower central-right area, partly cropped by neighboring divisions, while its body creates diagonal movement through the frame. Flower petals pass before the horse and rider, overlapping the bridge, legs, foliage, and bokeh-filled background. The environment suggests a secluded old village route or mountainous estate garden: a dusty uneven trail runs inward between grass banks, roots, shrubs, stony borders, and massive aged trees whose branches form a canopy filled densely with clusters of tiny pink blossoms. Light enters from the upper left and breaks into sparkling circular bokeh spots throughout the treescape. Distant mountains appear blurred behind the riders, tinted beige-green by misty warmth. The perspective feels documentary yet stylized, shot from roughly eye height with a moderate telephoto compression that keeps Peixinghang recognizable while dissolving the far orchard into luminous haze.

Below these, additional portions show alternate crops of Lianhua and Peixinghang maintaining identical appearance, costumes, prop states, spatial logic, lighting, and cinematic realism without stylistic drift. In the next lower section depicting Lianhua turning slowly, she now turns more fully sideways, lifting her gaze toward Pei Jingxing outside the frame with expressions conveying startled shyness. She displays the same fresh fair skin, almond eyes, red forehead ornament, glossy black hair styled in Tang dynasty hanging bun adorned with pink-blue gradient silk flowers and silver pearl tassel buyao, and cream outfit bearing pale pink small floral print paired with a pink-blue contrast pleated skirt body and soft pink chiffon cape. Crucially, she firmly grips a white embroidered round fan. The breeze visibly lifts locks of hair, scarf layers, and sleeve hems. Fallen petals scatter through sunbeams, creating suspended specks across the air. Rocks, low plants, and winding dirt surfaces repeat the earlier scenic geometry.

In the final lower-right segment presenting a dual-character reunion, Pei Jingxing (20 years old) bows respectfully in salute toward Lianxia (18 years old), who returns the courtesy by bending her knees. Their expressions reveal tenderness and affection. This concluding moment occurs amid rainlike showers of countless peach petals descending uniformly across the entire grid.

The image is a wide hand-drawn charcoal sketch portrait of a young East Asian woman rendered in a rough ink-and-charcoal illustration style, set against a textured off-white paper background with subtle grain and faint tonal variation across its surface. The background is a flat, unbleached cream paper with visible fibre texture, slightly darker at the edges suggesting a scanned or photographed sheet. In the upper-left quadrant, a large handwritten brush-script headline reads "Still Here" in thick black strokes, the letters loose and expressive with uneven weight, the word "Still" stacked above "Here" and a short horizontal dash beneath. Directly below that headline, two lines of small black serif type read "Same me." and "A quieter day." in a lighter, more restrained weight than the brush-script above. The central subject occupies the middle and lower half of the frame: a young woman depicted from the shoulders up, her face turned slightly toward the viewer with a calm, neutral expression. Her hair is rendered in dense, heavy charcoal strokes, long and dark, falling past her shoulders on both sides and parted near the centre of her head, with the texture of individual strokes visible throughout. Her face is left mostly unshaded, the paper white showing through for skin, while her eyes are drawn as small dark ovals with defined brows above them, and her lips are a small dark mark. On the upper-left of her head, a small butterfly-shaped hair clip is suggested with a few delicate lines, echoing the accessory in the source photograph. She wears a scoop-neck top rendered in rough cross-hatched charcoal, the leopard-print pattern suggested through irregular dark spots and patches rather than detailed rendering, the neckline curving low across her chest. A thin gold necklace with a small round pendant hangs at her collarbone, drawn as a fine single line with a tiny circle at its centre. On the right side of the frame, roughly at mid-height, a small black serif label reads "NO. 01" with a thin horizontal rule drawn directly beneath it. Below that, in the lower-right area, three short lines of small black serif type read "Some faces" "carry" "silent stories." stacked vertically with generous leading. The lighting is flat and even across the entire composition, with no cast shadows or highlights, consistent with a hand-drawn illustration on a paper surface where all depth comes from line weight and stroke density rather than light direction. The overall composition is balanced and minimalist, with the dense dark charcoal mass of the figure anchoring the centre while the sparse text elements float in the negative space on either side, creating a quiet, contemplative mood on a restrained palette of black ink on cream paper.

Create a photorealistic high-definition vertical 9:16 ancient-style portrait with the theme of serving tea in a stone bridge beside a moonlit water alley. Show one clearly adult East Asian woman with refined enduring features, a soft face, bright clear eyes, fair natural skin texture, and a pure gentle temperament. She looks directly into the lens as if looking softly at the viewer. She wears a moon-white, cream-white, or pale blue-white silk-satin ancient-style dress with real folds, delicate flower-branch embroidery, and flowing cuffs. Her black hair is in a semi-updo with loose strands, a slight night breeze, and restrained white floral, pearl, or jade hair ornaments. Use a high-angle first-person POV close interactive composition: she holds a complete teapot, teacup, or tea bowl up toward the lens near the viewer's eye level; the tea set is in the foreground and her clearly visible face is behind and slightly above it, creating the layered relationship of tea in front and person behind. The action is serving tea, with correctly proportioned spout, handle, cup mouth, natural liquid direction, slender natural fingers, and an elegant gentle gesture. Build a stone bridge beside a moonlit water alley with water reflections, warm lanterns, ancient architecture, night channels, and only a few softly blurred tourists. Mix cool blue night ambience with warm yellow practical lights, moderate background blur, natural lens depth, and soft night shadows. Emphasize the feeling that she is presenting tea directly to the viewer, not a static standing shot. Avoid underage or childlike styling, seductive provocation, flat expression, malformed fingers, distorted tea ware, wrong liquid direction, broken clothing, exaggerated anatomy, plastic skin, greasy face, warped background, watermarks, logos, text, low resolution, cartoon style, and CGI appearance.

按照以下故事发展，生成四宫格图：
【格 1 完整图片提示词】
极致写实古风人像摄影，18 岁大唐世家贵女沈清辞，肤若凝脂，眉眼温婉灵动，杏眼含情，额间点红色花钿，乌黑亮泽长发梳唐制垂挂髻，点缀粉蓝渐变绢花发饰与银质珍珠流苏步摇，身穿米白底印浅粉小碎花唐制齐胸襦裙
【格 2 完整图片提示词】
极致写实古风人像摄影，20 岁大唐羽林卫郎将裴景行，身姿挺拔俊朗，剑眉星目，面如冠玉，身穿月白暗纹唐制圆领袍，腰束嵌玉革带，足蹬黑色皂靴，骑白色骏马，手握缰绳勒马停下，目光望向桃林方向，表情温润带着一丝惊艳
【格 3 完整图片提示词】
极致写实古风人像摄影，18 岁大唐世家贵女沈清辞，肤若凝脂，眉眼温婉灵动，杏眼微睁，额间点红色花钿，乌黑亮泽长发梳唐制垂挂髻，点缀粉蓝渐变绢花发饰与银质珍珠流苏步摇，身穿米白底印浅粉小碎花唐制齐胸襦裙，粉蓝撞色百褶裙身，搭配柔粉色雪纺披帛，手持白色刺绣团扇，缓缓转过身，抬眸望向画面外的男主
【格 4 完整图片提示词】
极致写实古风双人摄影，画面左侧男主裴景行，20 岁，身姿挺拔，剑眉星目，身穿月白暗纹唐制圆领袍，对着女主拱手躬身行礼，眉眼温润带笑；画面右侧女主沈清辞，18 岁，肤若凝脂，杏眼含情，额间点红色花钿，固定唐制发型与粉蓝绢花发饰，身穿固定款齐胸襦裙与粉色披帛，微微屈膝敛衽回礼，唇角上扬，眉眼含情；
【本组四宫格总图超级提示词】
生成一张专业级超高清 2x2 四宫格故事板分镜图，四个面板必须保持同一角色外观、同一服装、同一道具状态、同一场景逻辑、同一光线逻辑，不允许风格漂移。每个面板严格为横版 16:9 比例。左上格 1（起）：大唐春日乐游原桃林，女主沈清辞执刺绣团扇，抬眸赏盛放的桃花，春风吹动发丝披帛；右上格 2（承）：男主裴景行骑白色骏马，在桃林土路勒马停下，目光望向桃林里的女主；左下格 3（转）：女主缓缓转过身，抬眸看向男主，眼神错愕羞怯，二人四目相对，桃花飘落；右下格 4（合）：男主翻身下马拱手行礼，女主屈膝回礼，二人相视一笑，漫天桃花飘落。整体要求：叙事清晰，构图优秀，角色一致，道具一致，空间一致，无字幕，无水印，无时间码，无多余文字，四宫格图片之间无缝相接，极致写实古风电影质感，8K 超高清，皮肤质感真实，光影细腻，画面无畸变
